# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 3 (Slot 95 oe_aip_): 6 Dynamic Historical AI Personalities & Global Eurasian Diplomatic/Expansion Choreography (0 vanilla overrides, 0 ai_diplochance). Generated by gen_v120_epic_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Slot 95 Epic AI Personalities & Global Choreography scripted effects (oe_aip_).
# Strictly staggered on Months 6 & 12 (never competes with v9.9 oe_ai2_ Month 3 pulse).
# CMDLOG = 0 compliant (zero log output commands on any path).

# Country scope. Evaluate and assign one of the 6 epic AI personalities if healthy & eligible.
# STRICT YIELD: Immediately skips if oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity or fiscal crisis is active!
oe_aip_eval_country = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_aip_can_shift_personality = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { oe_aip_elig_celestial_suzerain = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_aip_celestial_suzerain }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_celestial_suzerain
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_aip_elig_concert_balancer = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_aip_concert_balancer }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_concert_balancer
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_aip_elig_enlightened_reformer = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_aip_enlightened_reformer }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_enlightened_reformer
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_aip_elig_gunpowder_conqueror = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_aip_gunpowder_conqueror }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_gunpowder_conqueror
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_aip_elig_thalassocracy_hegemon = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_aip_thalassocracy_hegemon }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_thalassocracy_hegemon
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { oe_aip_elig_imperial_restorer = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ai_personality != ai_personality:oe_aip_imperial_restorer }
				set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_imperial_restorer
			}
			set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Refresh global distribution telemetry counters for oe_aip.90 readout.
oe_aip_recount_distribution = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_1 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_2 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_3 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_4 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_5 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_6 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_austerity value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_concert_members value = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				oe_aip_has_any_epic_personality = yes
				ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_imperial_restorer }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_1 add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_thalassocracy_hegemon }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_2 add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_celestial_suzerain }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_3 add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_gunpowder_conqueror }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_4 add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_enlightened_reformer }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_5 add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_concert_balancer }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_6 add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity }
			change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_austerity add = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert }
		international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
			every_international_organization_member = {
				change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_cnt_concert_members add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Execute one full global personality evaluation & telemetry recount immediately.
oe_aip_run_sync_now = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aip_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_init value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aip_guard_test_ok } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_guard_test_ok value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_aip_sync_runs }
		change_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_sync_runs add = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_sync_runs value = 1 }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_last_sync_y value = current_year }
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_last_sync_m value = oe_aip_month_num }
	if = {
		limit = { oe_aip_personality_enabled = yes }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				oe_aip_is_tracked_power = yes
			}
			oe_aip_eval_country = yes
		}
	}
	oe_aip_recount_distribution = yes
}

# Slot 95 public monthly entry point (called by gen_mainline_lock.py).
# O(1): immediately exits when Rule #18 is Off or on 10 of 12 months (runs only in Month 6, Month 12, or initial boot).
oe_aip_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { oe_aip_rule_is_off = yes }
			NOT = { global_var:oe_aip_ran_m ?= oe_ml_month_now }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_aip_init }
					current_month = 6
					current_month = 12
				}
			}
			oe_aip_run_sync_now = yes
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 88 Clean Helpers (oe_aip_dev_*, CMDLOG = 0)
# ==============================================================================

# Dev Page 88: Run one immediate personality sync pass regardless of calendar month.
oe_aip_dev_run_pulse = {
	oe_aip_run_sync_now = yes
}

# Dev Page 88: Apply personality #1 (Imperial Restorer) to current country & one independent AI neighbor.
oe_aip_dev_set_1 = {
	set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_imperial_restorer
	set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
	random_neighbor_country = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
		}
		set_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_imperial_restorer
		set_variable = oe_ai2_pers_init
	}
	oe_aip_recount_distribution = yes
}

# Dev Page 88: Self-test that oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity is NEVER overwritten by oe_aip_run_sync_now.
oe_aip_dev_test_austerity_guard = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_guard_test_ok value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			any_neighbor_country = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				oe_aip_is_tracked_power = yes
			}
		}
		random_neighbor_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
				oe_aip_is_tracked_power = yes
			}
			save_scope_as = oe_aip_guard_probe
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			any_great_power = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
			}
		}
		random_great_power = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
			}
			save_scope_as = oe_aip_guard_probe
		}
	}
	else = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_rebel_country = no
				is_subject = no
			}
			save_scope_as = oe_aip_guard_probe
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:oe_aip_guard_probe }
		scope:oe_aip_guard_probe = {
			set_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity
		}
		oe_aip_run_sync_now = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:oe_aip_guard_probe = {
					ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity
				}
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_guard_test_ok value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_aip_guard_test_ok value = 2 }
		}
	}
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aip.90
}

# Dev Page 88: Open live telemetry audit event oe_aip.90.
oe_aip_dev_readout = {
	oe_aip_recount_distribution = yes
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_aip.90
}

# Dev Page 88: Rule #18 live override toggles (1 = Standard, 2 = Concert Only, 3 = Off, unset = Pre-Game Rule).
oe_aip_dev_rule_standard = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 1 }
}

oe_aip_dev_rule_concert_only = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 2 }
}

oe_aip_dev_rule_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_v120_rule_override value = 3 }
}

oe_aip_dev_rule_clear = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_v120_rule_override }
		remove_global_variable = oe_v120_rule_override
	}
}
